column1: # Parity of the protocol capability set across the four surfaces (ADR-014).
# One row per capability; a cell names the RPC / tool / method that serves it, or `-`.
# `reason` is mandatory on a row with `-` in proto, mcp_grpc, mcp_embedded or facade. `api` is the versioned subset (ADR-004).
# Target: zero rows with a reason. The parity test fails when this file and the code disagree in either direction.
# The test is crates/made-mcp/src/mcp_protocol/parity_tests.rs; facade methods that are variants of a row are mapped there, never ignored.
